body:
All changes complete. Build passes (40 pages).

## Changes made

**src/pages/index.astro**
- Removed `import HeroTitle` and `<HeroTitle client:load />` usage
- Replaced with static `<h1>` containing letter spans + inline `<style>` with CSS `@keyframes` for staggered letter reveal (matches original Framer Motion timing: delayChildren 0.3s, stagger 0.08s)
- Subtitle now reads "Code • Guyana" (Music removed)
- Added `<noscript>` inside HeroScene container: "3D scene requires JavaScript"
- Added contact CTA section between `<BlogList>` and `<Footer>` with email, GitHub, LinkedIn links

**src/components/Hero/HeroScene.tsx:28-30**
- Added reduced-motion guard at top of component: `if (prefersReducedMotion) return null;`

**src/components/Hero/ScrollIndicator.tsx:4-21**
- Added `prefersReducedMotion` check; returns static non-animated version when reduced motion preferred

**src/layouts/Layout.astro:56**
- Removed `Inter:wght@400;500;600&` from Google Fonts link, kept JetBrains Mono only

## Verification
- `npx tsc --noEmit` — no errors
- `npx astro build` — 40 pages built successfully
- Built HTML confirms: "Code • Guyana" present (1), "Code • Music" absent (0), "Let's Work Together" present (1), JetBrains Mono present (1), Inter absent (0), noscript present (1)
- Hero name displays without JS (static h1 with CSS animation enhancement)
